What We Do
We Sell World-Class
Chinese Machinery

JR Textile Machineries is your direct source for buying premium textile machines from China. We buy directly from Chinese manufacturers and sell to factories across Bangladesh at competitive prices with zero compromise on quality.

Many factory owners want to import from China but face challenges with import licenses and customs. Whether you have a license or not, just send us your requirement and we handle everything.

Direct from Chinese Factory

We source all machines from verified Chinese manufacturers — no middlemen, best price, genuine quality.

No Import License Needed

We handle all customs clearance, port documentation and duties under our license. You do not need your own.

Door-to-Factory Delivery

From our Yangzhou China office straight to your factory floor in Bangladesh — fully managed end to end.

After-Sales Technical Support

Our expert technicians support machine installation, operator training and ongoing maintenance after every sale.

Why Buy From Us

Everything You Need, Nothing You Don't

Direct sourcing, full import handling, genuine parts — all from one trusted partner.

Best Factory Prices

Genuine Machines & Parts

Every machine and spare part is 100% genuine, sourced from verified Chinese factories with full quality inspection.

Fast & Reliable Delivery

How to Buy

Simple 5-Step Buying Process

No license required. No complicated paperwork. Just tell us what you need.

01

Send Requirement

WhatsApp or email us the machine type, quantity and factory details. We reply within hours.

02

Receive Quotation

We send a full price quotation with machine specs, lead time and delivery cost — no hidden fees.

03

Confirm & Pay

Agree on price and terms, confirm order and pay the deposit to begin sourcing from China.

04

We Handle Import

We manage the full import — customs, port clearance and all documentation from China to Bangladesh.

05

Delivered & Installed

Machine delivered to your factory with full installation, operator training and after-sales support.
